class.name: FlowExit
class.brief_description: One way to leave the current node of a [FlowGraphPlayback].

members.member: If [code]false[/code], [method FlowGraphPlayback.choose] refuses this exit. Show it grayed out, or hide it.
The text to show. The default exits use the label of the [FlowPort], else its name.
The node this exit leads to, or [code]-1[/code] if the output has no connection. Filled by [method FlowGraphPlayback.get_available_exits].
The flow output of the node that this exit leaves through.
